text: Kalila, you would never trust a hungry heron, right? But 10 little fish did, and they almost lost their home!
Ten little fish? Oh no! Who saved them?
Someone very small, with two very strong claws. Listen!
Once upon a time, by a sparkling blue lake, there lived an old heron. Every day, he caught fish for his dinner.
But now he was old and slow, and the fish swam away too fast.
Oh, my legs are tired, and my beak is slow. How will I get my dinner?
Hmm... If I cannot catch them, I will trick them!
So the heron stood by the water, looking very, very sad. A little crab saw him from her rock.
Uncle Heron, why are you so sad today?
Oh, little crab! I heard the fishermen talking. Tomorrow they will come with big nets, and take all the fish away!
Oh no! What can we do?
Please help us, Uncle Heron!
Don't worry, my dears. Behind the big rocks, there is a beautiful new lake. I will carry you there, one by one.
The fish believed his sweet words.
So every day, the heron carried a fish away in his beak. But there was no beautiful lake. He dropped them into a tiny muddy puddle, behind the rocks.
Hee hee! My little dinner pond. I will eat you all, one by one!
Help! This is not a beautiful lake!
Uncle Heron, take me too! I want to see the new lake.
A crab? Hmm, crab for dinner... Yes, yes! Climb up on my neck!
Up, up they flew, over the big rocks. The crab looked down, and she saw the tiny puddle, full of scared fish!
That is not a lake! You tricked us!
So the clever crab held on to the heron's neck with her claws, and... pinch!
Ow! Ow! Let me go!
First, put me down. And never trick the fish again!
Ow! All right, all right! I'm sorry! I'm going!
The heron put the crab down, and flew far, far away. And he never came back.
Then the crab dug a little stream with her claws, from the puddle, all the way back to the lake. And all the fish swam home!
Hooray! Thank you, clever crab!
Remember, friends: sweet words are not always true words!
So the heron said sweet words, but they were lies. Only the crab looked with her own eyes.
Don't believe sweet lies! Look and check first!
Persian word of the day! In Persian, a fish is maahi. Maahi! Blub, blub!
Maahi. A fish. And our little maahi are safe at home now.
And next time: a tortoise who wants to fly, and two kind ducks with a stick.
